name: manage-iacm
description: Manage Harness Infrastructure as Code Management (IaCM) via MCP. Configure Terraform workspaces with remote state and RBAC, set up continuous drift detection with auto-remediation, design multi-tier change approval workflows, and estimate infrastructure costs before deployment. Use when asked to manage Terraform workspaces, detect infrastructure drift, set up approval workflows for infrastructure changes, or estimate Terraform costs. Do NOT use for creating Harness infrastructure definitions (use create-infrastructure instead) or OPA policies (use create-policy instead). Trigger phrases: terraform, workspace, drift detection, infrastructure cost, IaCM, state management, change approval, terraform plan, infracost, infrastructure governance.
